arguments.sql: SELECT printf('%05d', ml.zip) AS zip_code, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'MA' AND ml.zip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ml.zip ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, ml.zip ASC LIMIT 1
arguments.explanation: Finds the Massachusetts ZIP code with the highest number of transactions, returned as a five-digit text value.
assumptions: Counted all transactions, labelled or not, since the question asks about total transaction count.
Location taken from transactions.merchant_location_id joined to merchant_locations, with state = 'MA'.
Transactions with a NULL ZIP were excluded.
ZIP stored as an integer, so it is zero-padded to five digits with printf('%05d') to restore leading zeros.
Ties in transaction count broken by the lower ZIP code.
